name: Aviva plc
summary: Aviva plc provides various insurance, retirement, and wealth products in the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada, India, and China. It operates through General Insurance; Insurance, Wealth & Retirement; Aviva Investors; and International Investments segments. The company offers gadget, home, motor, pet, and health insurance, as well as commercial, specialty insurance and protection.
